did: The planner removed the scope field from the last sample plan that still had it.
The worker changed no code this round; its earlier build stands.
decided: The worker kept the scope as the criteria's files plus the plan's test files.
open: GitHub's checks on the final commit still show red from before the plan was approved.

handback.summary: The code does what the four criteria ask, and every test passes; GitHub's checks must turn green before merging.

behaviors.why: The scope is the criteria's files plus the plan's test files.
A plan with a scope field is rejected.
The fence undoes changes to files no criterion lists.
A criterion without the owner's words is rejected.

tests.why: Checks the posted scope is the criteria's files plus test files, each once.
Accepts a plan with no scope; rejects one with scope, even empty.
The planner's instructions no longer show a scope field.
Runs the real fence; listed changes stay, the unlisted one is undone.
Runs the real fence; a new unlisted file is removed.
Accepts the owner's words; refuses missing, invented or misplaced words.
